quests.title: Glory's Wish

dialogue.sit: So, I hear you need dandelions...

dialogue.t: Ah, did you come over to help after seeing my request? Thank you so much...
Have you brought the Dandelion Seeds?
Please put them in my hand... Thank you.
Yes, these are Dandelion Seeds, indeed. Thank you very much.
Ah, yes. I have a small gift for you. Please take it.
May my wishes travel well with the wind...

quests.description: Glory from Mondstadt needs three sets of Dandelion Seeds.
